exclusion.reason: The exact contract requires complete deployed replacement-certificate history, including deployedAt and a timely replacement before the expiry threshold. Certificate Manager read-only certificates.list/get exposes current usedBy references and certificate state/expiry, not historical deployment timestamps or replacement deployment completeness; do not fabricate deployment or treat current references as timely renewal proof.

The exact historical-deployment contract requires a verified deployed-certificate association before evaluating rotation age. Native certificate createTime is resource creation and managed renewal can replace the leaf without recreating that resource; current usedBy references do not provide the required historical deployment/rotation record. Archive this literal contract rather than invent deployment status or claim effective rotation from resource age.

The exact contract requires deployed leaf issuance age plus a verified deployment association. The current read-only native producer returns current usedBy references and redacts PEM; it does not provide a reviewed deployed-leaf notBefore/history projection. Do not manufacture deployment records or force a positive with custom PEM metadata; a new safe issuance observer would need a separate reviewed contract.

The literal contract requires every effective route of an internet-facing URL map to replace the Server header with the custom value lb. Native URL maps provide declarations but the producer supplies neither public serving topology nor complete inherited effective-header routes, and no provider requirement establishes the customer-specific Server=lb convention. Exclude this unautomatable exact custom contract rather than fabricate internetFacing/effectiveRoutes markers or customer approval.
